title: BliQ Messaging Platform
description: Enterprise-grade multi-tenant communication platform supporting WhatsApp, SMS, VoIP, real-time chat, broadcast campaigns, contact synchronization, billing, and usage management. Led a three-member engineering team across architecture, development, code reviews, testing, and production delivery. Built scalable inbound and outbound messaging workflows for media, reactions, read receipts, interactive messages, and delivery-status tracking. Optimized queue-based broadcast processing with batching and database-query reduction for large-volume concurrent campaigns, while developing billing, authentication, Google Contacts synchronization, WebSocket events, and phone-level VoIP configuration features.
role: Software Development Engineer I & Team Lead

title: Techflu - Tech Rental Platform (B2B & B2C)
description: Tech rental platform supporting individual customers and enterprise bulk rental operations. Developed scalable backend services using NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, and cron jobs for inventory reservations and rental workflows. Implemented booking systems, Razorpay AutoPay integrations, order management, and real-time inventory tracking. Built admin and delivery partner management systems for order tracking, KYC approvals, delivery workflows, and operational operations. Integrated Digio Aadhaar verification and Amazon S3 storage for secure proof and document management, plus discount systems, promo codes, and scalable order-processing pipelines.

title: Reusable Multi-Tenant Identity Platform (IDP)
description: Developed a scalable multi-tenant Identity Provider supporting JWT authentication, OTP login, Google OAuth, and role-based access control. Designed centralized authentication architecture with reusable APIs and user management features using Java Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and React.js. Focused on tenant isolation, secure token workflows, authorization boundaries, and reusable identity services for SaaS applications.

title: Self-Hosted Home Server Platform
description: Built a personal self-hosted cloud infrastructure platform using an old laptop as a dedicated home server to deploy and manage full-stack applications and backend services. Designed a production-style hosting environment with Docker-based containerized deployments, Nginx reverse proxy routing, Cloudflare secure public access, and MinIO S3-compatible object storage. Implemented backend deployment pipelines with environment variable and secret file management, along with self-hosted alternatives for services similar to Vercel and Supabase.

title: Cloudverse - Cloud Management & FinOps Platform
description: Contributed to a cloud management and FinOps platform by developing the Chargeback module for enterprise cloud cost allocation and financial analytics. Built backend services for pool-based cost allocation, direct and shared cost distribution, Reserved Instance and Savings Plan allocations, and ledger-based cost tracking across organizational cost centers. Implemented automated ledger generation and cost processing workflows using scheduled jobs and analytics pipelines.

title: Realm - Real Estate Mobile Application
description: Developed a cross-platform real estate mobile application for Android and iOS enabling users to explore residential and commercial properties, view property details, and schedule appointments with property dealers. Built mobile UI flows, API integrations, authentication, property listing management, appointment booking workflows, and production deployment processes using Ionic Capacitor.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Modern portfolio with React 19, TailwindCSS 4, Three.js animations, SEO optimization, and responsive design.
